col_DA.note: Source-correct value cannot be stored without tripping the pipeline's own DA gate. The announcement (p16, PUBLIC FLOAT AND FREE FLOAT) states that at least 50% of the 107,659,000 Offer Shares are not subject to lock-up = 53,829,500 H Shares (HK$645,954,000 / HK$12.00), i.e. 'at least 7.56% of the total number of issued share capital (excluding treasury shares)' (712,043,659 = 717,724,893 - 5,681,234 treasury shares) => 0.0756, or 0.0750 on the col_CZ base 717,724,893; prospectus p208 explains why: 'at least 50% of the Offer Shares will not be subject to lock-up at the time of the Listing'. That is NOT storable: src/validate.py check_allot requires col_DA within 20% of (col_CS x (1-col_CK)) / col_CZ = 0.1500 and contracts.derived_allowed whitelists only that formula value, so 0.0756 raises the validation error '自由流通比例口径可疑'. Storing 0.15 would merely duplicate col_CY (total public float, which includes the locked-up portion) and contradict the same page; per the reviewer brief a genuinely disclosed value rejected by a pipeline guard is left missing and reported as a finding (the DA formula/gate needs an upstream fix), so the field is left missing instead.

col_DB.value: Free float denominator = total number of issued Shares upon Listing (col_CZ 717,724,893), the base used for the 15.00% public-float statement; the announcement's Rule 19A.13C(2)(b) free float is struck on the ex-treasury base 717,724,893 - 5,681,234 = 712,043,659. Numerator = H Shares held by the public and not subject to lock-up = at least 53,829,500 Shares (>=50% of the 107,659,000 Offer Shares; HK$645,954,000 / HK$12.00), i.e. at least 7.56% on the ex-treasury base (0.0750 on col_CZ); the remaining Offer Shares are subject to lock-up.
